comment:
No actionable defect found in the source-reviewed scope at `0692a85`.

**Verified (source inspection):** Both submenu stack writes now use `Qt.callLater`, moving the Repeater model change out of the triggering click handler. Leaving a submenu still updates the stack before destroying the removed opener.

```text
Before: click handler -> stack write -> Repeater rebuild, still inside handler
After:  click handler -> queue callback -> handler returns
                        callback -> stack write -> Repeater rebuild
```
